items.title: S&P 500 investors may have more tech exposure than they think: Here's how one wealth manager mitigates concentration risk
items.summary: Kenny Polcari says investors using market-weighted S&P 500 funds should examine their technology concentration before adding more tech-focused ETFs or buying the next pullback.

items.title: Should You Buy IBM Stock For Its Cash?
items.summary: IBM's free cash flow equals 6.3% of its market value, against 4.5% for the median S&P 500 company. A yield that high means one of two things: investors are underpricing a sound business, or they expect it to shrink. Which of those is IBM—and is its cash strong enough to justify buying now, or should investors wait for proof.

items.title: A Year Ago, We Called IBM the Next Nvidia. It Lost Money but Still Beat Every Quantum Startup.
items.summary: Twelve months after a bold quantum computing call promised four-figure returns, the scorecard arrived with a twist: the pick lost money, yet still outperformed every pure-play rival in the sector. Here is what that split verdict reveals about the trade.

items.title: Can You Justify Buying Palantir Stock Today?
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) stock trades at 73 times its sales over the last twelve months, against about 3 times for the S&P 500. Revenue is growing fast, but buyers at this price are paying for years of profit Palantir has not earned yet. So can you justify buying Palantir stock today.
